विरक्ति f. 1. Change of disposition, disinclination, dissatisfaction; 2. freedom from passion or worldly attachment.
विरचन n. 1. Arranging, constructing; 2. embellishing; 3. composing, composition.
विरचना f. 1. Arranging, constructing; 2. embellishing; 3. composing, composition.
विरचित a. (f. ता) 1. Arranged, formed, constructed; 2. trimmed; 3. put on, worn; 4. set, inlaid; 5. embellished, ornamented; 6. written, composed.

विरज (I) a. (f. जा) free from dust.
विराज m. The same as विराज् q.v.
विरजस् a. 1. Free from dust; 2. free from passion; 3. free from menstrual excretion.
विरजस्का f. A woman who has ceased to menstruate.
विरजस्क a. (f. स्का) 1. Free from dust; 2. free from passion; 3. free from menstrual excretion.
विरजस्क a. (f. स्का) 1. Free from dust; 2. free from passion; 3. free from menstrual excretion.

विरंच m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).
विरट m. A kind of agallochum.
विराट m. 1. Name of a district; 2. name of a king of the Matsyas. (See App. II.)
विरण m. A kind of fragrant grass.
वीरण n. Name of a fragrant grass.
विरत a. (f. ता) 1. Desisting from, (with an abl.); 2. stopped, ceased; 3. ended, concluded.
विरत a. (f. ता) 1. Desisting from, (with an abl.); 2. stopped, ceased; 3. ended, concluded.
विरति f. 1. Cessation, stop, rest, end; 2. indifference to worldly pursuits, विरतिवनितासंगमुदितः Bhartr.iii.79.
विरम m. 1. Cessation, stop; 2. sunset.
विराम m. 1. Cessation, discontinuance; 2. end, termination, conclusion, हरिरभिमानी रजनिरिदानीमियमपि याति विरामम् Git.G.v.; 3. pause of the voice; 4. a small stroke marking the end of a sentence.
विरल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Separated by intervals, (either of space or time), भवति विरलभक्तिर्म्लानपुष्पोपहारः R.v.74; 2. rare, unfrequent; 3. remote; 4. little, few, विरलातपच्छविरनुष्णवपुः Sis.ix.3.
विरल (II) n. Coagulated milk.(विरलम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘rarely, unfrequently.’)
विरल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Separated by intervals, (either of space or time), भवति विरलभक्तिर्म्लानपुष्पोपहारः R.v.74; 2. rare, unfrequent; 3. remote; 4. little, few, विरलातपच्छविरनुष्णवपुः Sis.ix.3.
विराल m. The same as बिडाल q.v.
विरल-जानुक n. bandy-legged.
विरल-द्रवा f. a kind of gruel.
विरस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Tasteless, flavourless, insipid; 2. painful.
विरस (II) m. Pain.
विरस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Tasteless, flavourless, insipid; 2. painful.
विरह m. 1. Absence in general; 2. abandonment, relinquishment-; 3. want; 4. the separation of lovers, कः सन्नद्धे विरहविधुरां त्वय्युपेक्षेत जायाम् Megh.i.8, 12, 29, ii.22.
विरह-अनल m. the fire of separation.
विरह-उत्कंठ a. pining away in absence.
विरह-उत्कंठिता f. a woman distressed by the absence of her lover.
विरह-ज्वर m. the anguish of separation.
विरहिणी f. 1. A woman separated from her lover; 2. wages.
विरहिन् a. (f. णी) Absent from another, separated from a beloved person, विरहिनिकृंतनकुंतमुखाकृतिकेतकिदंतुरिताशे Git.G.i.
विरहित a. (f. ता) 1. Abandoned, deserted, relinquished; 2. bereft of, destitute of; 3. lonely, solitary.
विरहित a. (f. ता) 1. Abandoned, deserted, relinquished; 2. bereft of, destitute of; 3. lonely, solitary.
विरहिन् a. (f. णी) Absent from another, separated from a beloved person, विरहिनिकृंतनकुंतमुखाकृतिकेतकिदंतुरिताशे Git.G.i.
विराग m. 1. Change of colour; 2. change of disposition, disinclination, dissatisfaction; 3. indifference to all worldly pursuits.
विराज् (I) m. 1. Splendour, beauty; 2. a man of the Kṣatriya caste; 3. the body; 4. the first progeny of Brahman (m.); See M.i.32.
विराज् (II) f. Name of a Vedic metre.
विराजित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested; 2. illuminated.
विराजित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested; 2. illuminated.
विराट-ज m. an inferior kind of diamond.
विराटक m. An inferior kind of diamond.
विराणिन् m. An elephant.
विराद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Opposed; 2. injured, offended, treated with disrespect, विराद्ध एवं भवता विराद्धा बहुधा च नः Sis.ii.41.
विराद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Opposed; 2. injured, offended, treated with disrespect, विराद्ध एवं भवता विराद्धा बहुधा च नः Sis.ii.41.
विराध m. 1. Opposition; 2. vexation, annoyance.
विराधन n. 1. Injuring, hurting; 2. pain, agony.
विराव m. Noise, sound, आलोकशब्दं वयसां विरावैः R.ii.9.
विराविणी f. 1. Weeping, crying; 2. a broom.
विरिंच m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).
विरिंच m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).
विरिंचि m. 1. An epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva.
विरिण n. The same as इरिण q.v.
वीरिण n. The same as ईरिण q.v.
विरुग्ण a. (f. ग्णा) 1. Broken to pieces, destroyed; 2. bent; 3. blunted.
विरुग्ण a. (f. ग्णा) 1. Broken to pieces, destroyed; 2. bent; 3. blunted.
विरुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Screamed; 2. resounding.
विरुत (II) n. 1. Singing, humming, chirping, परभृतविरुतं कलं यथा प्रतिवचनीकृतमेभिरीदृशम् Sak.iv.; 2. din, noise, clamour.
विरुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Screamed; 2. resounding.
विरुद m. 1. Proclaiming; 2. a panegyric, a laudatory poem, पठंति विरुदावलीरहितमंदिरे बंदिनः R.G.
विरुदित n. Loud lamentation.

विरुद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Opposed, checked, obstructed; 2. besieged, blockaded; 3. opposed in quality; 4. contradictory, inconsistent; 5. unfavourable, unpropitious; 6. prohibited, forbidden; 7. hostile, adverse; 8. disqualified; 9. proving the reverse, as a Hetu) (in logic).
विरुद्ध (II) n. Opposition, hostility, discord.

विरुद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Opposed, checked, obstructed; 2. besieged, blockaded; 3. opposed in quality; 4. contradictory, inconsistent; 5. unfavourable, unpropitious; 6. prohibited, forbidden; 7. hostile, adverse; 8. disqualified; 9. proving the reverse, as a Hetu) (in logic).
विरुद्ध-अन्न n. forbidden food.
विरूक्षण n. 1. The act of roughening; 2. blame, censure; 3. an imprecation.

विरूप-अक्ष (II) m. an epithet of Śiva, या नः प्रीतिर्विरूपाक्ष त्वदनुध्यानसंभवा K.S.vi.21, विरूपाक्षस्य जयिनीस्ताः स्तुवे वामलोचनाः K.Pr.x.
विरूप-करण n. disfiguring, injuring.
विरूप-चक्षुस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
विरूपिन् a. (f. णी) Deformed, ugly, misshapen.
विरूपिन् a. (f. णी) Deformed, ugly, misshapen.
विरेक m. 1. Evacuation of the bowels; 2. a purgative.
विरेचन n. The same as विरेक q.v.
विरेचित a. (f. ता) Purged, evacuated.
विरेचित a. (f. ता) Purged, evacuated.
विरेफ m. 1. A river, a stream; 2. absence of the letter र्.
विरोक (I) m.n. A hole, a chasm.
विरोक (II) m. A ray of light.
विरोचन m. 1. The sun; 2. the moon; 3. fire; 4. name of the son of Prahrāda.
विरोचन-सुत m. an epithet of the demon Bali.

विरोध m. 1. Opposition, obstruction, impediment; 2. restraint, check; 3. a siege, a blockade; 4. hostility, enmity, मुक्तशेषविरोधेन कुलिशव्रणलक्ष्मणा (गरुत्मता) R.x.13; 5. calamity, misfortune; 6. inconsistency, contradiction; 7. a rhetorical inconsistency which is apparent and can be explained away; it consists in describing things as existing together though in the nature of things they ought not so to exist, (विरोधः सोऽविरोधेन विरुद्धत्वेन यद्वचः K.Pr.x.).
विरोध-आभास m. the same as विरोध (7) q.v.
विरोध-उक्ति f. contradiction, opposition.
विरोधन n. 1. Hindering, obstructing; 2. besieging, blockading; 3. resistance, opposition; 4. inconsistency.
विरोधिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Opposing, obstructing; 2. besieging; 3. contradictory, inconsistent; 4. hostile, adverse, विरोधितत्वोज्झितपूर्वमत्सरम् K.S.v.17; 5. quarrelsome.
विरोधिन् (II) m. An enemy.
विरोधिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Opposing, obstructing; 2. besieging; 3. contradictory, inconsistent; 4. hostile, adverse, विरोधितत्वोज्झितपूर्वमत्सरम् K.S.v.17; 5. quarrelsome.
विरोप(ह)ण n. Healing (as a wound), Sak.iv.
विरोप(ह)ण n. Healing (as a wound), Sak.iv.
वीर (I) a. (f. रा) Mighty, powerful, strong.

वीर (II) m. 1. A hero, a warrior, a soldier, शस्त्रक्षताश्वद्विपवीरजन्मा बालारुणोऽभूद् रुधिरप्रवाहः R.vii.42; 2. an actor; 3. fire; 4. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 5. sacrificial fire; 6. a son; 7. a husband; 8. the sentiment of heroism (in rhetoric); (it is fourfold- दानवीर, धर्मवीर, दयावीर and युद्धविर; these varieties will be found explained in their proper places).
वीर (III) n. 1. A reed; 2. pepper; 3. rice-gruel.
वीर (I) a. (f. रा) Mighty, powerful, strong.
वीरा f. 1. The wife of a hero; 2. a wife; 3. a mother; 4. the plantain tree; 5. a kind of perfume also called Murā; 6. spirituous liquor.
वीर-आशंसन n. 1. a post of danger in a battle; 2. a forlorn hope.
वीर-आसन n. 1. a particular posture in sitting; 2. a field of battle.
वीर-ईश्वर m. an epithet of Śiva.
वीर-उज्झ m. a Brāhmaṇa who neglects his sacrificial fire.
वीर-कीट m. a contemptible warrior.
वीर-जयंतिका f. 1. war, battle; 2. a war-dance.
वीर-तर (I) m. 1. a great hero; 2. an arrow.
वीर-तर (II) n. a kind of fragrant grass.
वीर-तरु m. the Arjuna tree.
वीर-धन्वन् m. the god of love.
वीरंधर m. 1. a peacock; 2. a leather-jack; 3. fighting with beasts.
वीर-पाण, -पान n. an invigorating drink taken by warrior before or after, a battle.
वीर-पाण, -पान n. an invigorating drink taken by warrior before or after, a battle.
वीर-भद्र m. 1. name of a hero produced by Śiva; 2. a horse fit for sacrifice; 3. a kind of fragrant grass.
वीर-मुद्रिका f. a ring worn on the middle toe.
वीर-रजस् n. red lead.
वीर-रेणु m. an epithet of Bhīmasena.
वीर-रस m. warlike feeling.
वीर-वती f. a woman whose husband and sons are living.
वीर-वृक्ष m. 1. the Arjuna tree; 2. the marking-nut plant.
वीर-सू f. mother of a hero.
वीर-सैन्य n. garlic.
वीर-स्कंध m. a buffalo.
वीर-हन् n. a Brāhmaṇa who has neglected his sacred domestic fire.
वीरणी f. 1. A side-glance; 2. a deep place.
वीरुध् f. 1. A spreading creeper, अभिभूय विभूतिमार्तवीं मधुगंधातिशयेन वीरुधाम् R.viii.36, K.S.v.34; 2. a branch, a shoot; 3. a plant which grows after cutting; 4. a bower, Kir.iv.19.
वीरुध् f. 1. A spreading creeper, अभिभूय विभूतिमार्तवीं मधुगंधातिशयेन वीरुधाम् R.viii.36, K.S.v.34; 2. a branch, a shoot; 3. a plant which grows after cutting; 4. a bower, Kir.iv.19.

वीर्य n. 1. Vigour, strength; 2. prowess, valour, heroism, R.ii.4, iii.62, xi.47, 72; 3. virility; 4. semen virile; 5. splendour, lustre; 6. dignity, consequence; 7. efficacy, अतिवीर्यवतीव भेषजे बहुरल्पीयसि दृश्यते गुणः Kir.ii.24.
वीर्य-ज m. a son.
वीर्य-प्रपात m. discharge of semen virile.
वीर्य-वत् a. 1. strong, vigorous; 2. efficacious.
